description: One filed report by its filing_id from find_filings: every line as filed with its label, unit and amount; which claim counts are withheld and why (counts of 1 to 5 are never given); how each figure was checked; any discrepancies recorded between figures the report prints; the official file's address, size and SHA-256; and the ClinX page. For a workbook, the cell each figure was read from. One answer holds 100 lines, or up to 150 with limit, and fewer where the lines are long. A longer report is given in parts: the answer says how many lines are left and how to ask for the next part with offset, or for one schedule.

limit.description: How many lines to return (default 100, at most 150).

offset.description: How many lines to skip, for the next part of a long report (default 0). The answer names the offset of the next part.

schedule.description: Only the lines of this schedule, as the line list names it (for example G). The answer lists the schedules the report has.

name: get_filing
title: One filed 340B report in full
